clips.title: The story
paras: In the Valley of Trials, a message from Ken'jai reaches young priests after their first test. The tablet calls them to learn how Darkspear priests commune with the spirits.

After you prove yourself against the boars under Gornek's watch, he gives you an inscribed stone called the Hallowed Tablet. Its message bears Ken'jai's mark. The Darkspear mystic waits outside the Den, where he watches over newcomers drawn to faith and spiritual magic.

Darkspear priests among the Horde seek communion with spirits and loa, unlike human and dwarven priests who follow the Holy Light across the sea. Ken'jai welcomes you to Durotar and teaches that your power grows through spiritual discipline. He will instruct you in greater rites as your bond with the spirits matures.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, friend.
Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the priest trainer Ken'jai. He would have words with you when you're ready.

clips.title: Progress
paras: So ya made it... Good good! Da spirits tol' me you be comin' to see Ken'jai soon enough. Let me be one o' da first to welcome ya to da Valley of Trials. Dis place not be your home fer long, but while it is, why dontcha make da best o' it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: As ya test yeself, ya'll find ya have better an' better control o'er da spirits--ya'll be callin' on dem fer greata an' greata tings... Dat's where ol' Ken'jai come in. You come talk to ole Ken'jai when ya feel yer ready. If da spirits agree, den we see 'bout teachin' ya more powerful abilities... But only if da spirits agree.
Go now, talk to da rest of da Valley's people. Speak to me again later.
